relations: The bubble's dome lowers and narrows as its upper edge shifts downward and right boundary moves left.
Thin-film colors swirl and deform, breaking the broad pink and purple stripe into flowing patterns.
Small dark patches with greenish reflections emerge within the colored region, mainly toward the lower-left.
The background foliage and sky remain fixed while the bubble's surface continuously changes shape and color.
caption: The video captures a large iridescent soap bubble on the left, its dome showing cyan, yellow, green, pink and purple bands. Behind it, green foliage on the left, reddish-brown leaves on the right, and a pale sky remain unchanged. The bubble's upper edge and bright color band shift downward, while its right boundary gradually moves leftward, making the visible dome appear to lower and narrow. The thin-film colors continually swirl, merge and deform, so the broad pink and purple stripe becomes a more broken, flowing pattern. Small dark patches with greenish reflections appear within the colored region, mainly toward the lower-left part of the bubble. Darker patches also spread through the lower film, altering the contrast between vivid bands and transparent areas. The tree branches, leaves and sky appear fixed, with no evident camera pan, tilt or zoom. The bubble's surface keeps changing shape and color distribution, with no visible pop, contact, or off-screen manipulation shown. The process remains ongoing, with the bubble still present and shifting as the view continues.
